text:
Kai: FYI morning spend burned 40% of search daily budget by 11:30. pacing algorithm overshot after creative swap. we should pause broad-match and run a retarget segmentation test today.

Lina: ouch. propose quick three-arm test: (A) current creative + wide retarget, (B) new creative + 30d engaged, (C) new creative + 7d viewers. 10% holdback global. keep to top 5 high-intent kws only.

Omar: I can implement. which keywords?

Lina: `redwood inference`, `hosted llm api`, `reduce inference cost`, `inference latency`, `LLM serving platform`. add negatives: "free", "open source download".

AdOps Bot: hourly-check-238765.csv -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/238765/hourly.csv (AM CTR -0.8, CPC +11%).

Bea: landing variants? short headline vs stat-led?

Lina: short headline + stat-led. filenames uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/launch/morning_seg (files: seg_A_short.jpg, seg_B_stat.jpg, lp_short.html, lp_stat.html).

Omar: canary plan: 6h window, 15% spend, scale to 40% if CTR delta >= +6% and CPL <= -12%. pacing smoothing = 0.28. frequency cap for retarget = 2/day.

Kai: budget adjust for test day: search $10k/day, retarget $3k/day. holdback 10% traffic. disable auto-bid boosts >8% during canary.

Omar: webhook test for inbound mapping (CRM expects gclid + utm_content):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"google","gclid":"test-238765","utm_campaign":"morning_seg","utm_content":"seg_B_stat"}'
```

Bea: I'll QA the LPs and add a short hero variant with customer stat. also drafting 2 headline copy options to test.

Omar: analytics will create cohorts: seg_holdback, seg_A, seg_B, seg_C. pushing dashboard tiles for CTR, CPC, CPL, SQL rate, and lead latency. set Looker alert for CPL >20% vs baseline for 2 consecutive windows.

Kai: ops note: if webhook latency > 600ms, route leads to fallback queue and tag for manual review. maintain conversion lookback 30d.

Lina: fine. final checklist: Omar deploy canary by 2pm PT; Bea confirm assets uploaded; Kai monitor pacing first 3h. update here when live. :rocket:

Omar: deploying canary now. will post canary log link.

AdOps Bot: canary_log_238765.txt -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/canary/238765/log.txt

Bea: assets live and tagged. :white_check_mark:

Omar: gclid test returned 200 and payload present in CRM test endpoint. cohorts created.

Kai: monitoring first 2h. early signal looks ok, CTR +3% but CPC slightly up. keep updates short.
